arStrings.szText: Meet Deckard Cain at the Imperial Library of Caldeum

The old man claimed he was none other than Deckard Cain, the famous Horadrim. Hard to believe... From what Lorath told me, the man has been dead for decades. Regardless, "Deckard" asked for my help and to meet him at the Imperial Library of Caldeum. Very well. I have questions for him.
Meet Deckard at the Imperial Library of Caldeum

Deckard seems genuine. A lost soul, returned to Sanctuary like so many others lately. He says the dark stranger from the tavern, this "Aidan," is one of three who returned with him. Three who must be stopped. Tal Rasha, the Horadrim who once became the vessel of Baal, is the first I must find, last seen heading into the Fractured Peaks.

I found Tal Rasha wandering outside the ruined town of Nostrava. He seemed confused, tormented...shouting something in old Horadric. When I managed to subdue him, he gave a dire warning about "Harrogath" and "the Worldstone." I almost told him both are long gone, but then, a strange portal opened. Whatever torments him must be inside.
